requirements.requirement: The system must define a TypeScript interface that includes a top-level numeric overall_score field.
The system must define a measures array in the interface where each item represents a scored measure.
The system must require each measure object to include a name field of type string.
The system must require each measure object to include a numeric score field.
The system must require each measure object to include a numeric weight field representing contribution weight.
The system must include a contribution field per measure representing the weighted contribution to the overall score.
The system must define all fields in the interface using explicit TypeScript types with no use of any.
The system must ensure the interface is compatible with structured rendering expectations in MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must align field names and structure with backend outputs from EVAL-EXPLAIN without requiring transformation at render time.
The system must support optional fields in the interface for cases where backend data is partially available.
The system must allow the measures array to be empty without causing type validation failure.
The system must define the interface in a shared frontend location accessible by MessageBubble and related components.
The system must enforce that overall_score is present even when measures are missing.
The system must define a fallback-safe type structure such that undefined or null measure fields do not break TypeScript compilation.
The system must ensure that invalid payload shapes fail TypeScript type checking at compile time.
